states.name: korean-war
states.description: South Korea holds US 2 / USSR 1, with US-controlled Japan next door (-1 to the roll). Korean War wins on a modified 4+, replacing the US influence and paying the USSR 2 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: korean-war-two-us-neighbours
states.description: As korean-war, but the US also controls Taiwan: -2 to the roll, so only a 6 wins. USSR to act.

states.name: korean-war-vp-win
states.description: VP is -18; a winning Korean War takes the USSR to -20 and the game. USSR to act.

states.name: arab-israeli-war
states.description: Israel holds US 4 (US-controlled: -1 to the roll). Arab-Israeli War wins on a modified 4+. USSR to act.

states.name: arab-israeli-war-after-camp-david
states.description: Camp David Accords has already been played (removed from the game), so Arab-Israeli War's event can't be used. USSR to act.

states.name: indo-pakistani-war-us
states.description: The US plays Indo-Pakistani War: India holds USSR 3, Pakistan USSR-controlled. Attacking India is -1 (Pakistan); Pakistan itself has no USSR-controlled neighbour. US to act.

states.name: brush-war-ussr
states.description: The USSR plays Brush War: Afghanistan (stability 2) holds US 3, Iran US-controlled next door. A modified 3+ wins for 1 VP. USSR to act.

states.name: iran-iraq-war-us
states.description: The US plays Iran-Iraq War: Iraq holds USSR 2, Iran holds US 3. US to act.
